response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior individual contributor with broad full-stack, distributed-systems, and open-source experience, but the resume shows no executive or engineering-management track record, no evidence of scaling teams from 10 to 30+, and no production multi-agent AI systems beyond recent MCP tooling contributions. Fintech exposure (RIDE Capital) is brief and IC-level. The gap between this profile and a CTO role owning agentic-AI architecture, regulated fintech infrastructure, and organizational leadership is too large to justify an interview for this position.
strengths: 20 years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, embedded, and high-throughput low-latency systems (millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Strong engineering-craft culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source authorship, teaching, and community workshops
concerns: No people-leadership or executive experience; no evidence of scaling or managing engineering organizations
No demonstrated production multi-agent AI systems, LLM evaluation methodology, or AI reliability engineering at scale
Fintech and regulated-environment experience is limited to a ~15-month IC role, far short of the required depth

key_factors.factor: Lack of production multi-agent AI experience
